results.description:
Pypets gives you a tiny pixel pet that studies when you study.

Start the focus timer and your pet gets to work beside you. It walks across your Dynamic Island, lives on your Home Screen, and earns XP for every minute you stay on task. Put the phone down, lock in, and watch something small and cute grow because of it.

A STUDY BUDDY THAT LIVES ON YOUR PHONE
Your pet doesn't stay hidden behind an app icon. While the timer runs, it wanders through your Dynamic Island and Lock Screen as a Live Activity. Between sessions it sits in a Home Screen widget, where you can feed it or start a new session with one tap.

EVERY FOCUSED MINUTE IS XP
One minute of focus earns one XP. There are no levels to grind and nothing ever resets: your XP is a lifetime total that only goes up. If you stop mid-session, your partial minute carries over, so no effort is wasted.

KEEP YOUR STREAK, EARN BONUS XP
Focus on any day and your streak starts paying out: 5 bonus XP on day one, plus 5 more for every day you keep it going. Day 10 is worth 50. Miss a day and it starts over, so show up tomorrow.

PICK YOUR QUICK, FOCUS OR DEEP MODE
Choose a 5-minute sprint, a classic 25-minute focus block, a 50-minute deep-work session, or set your own length.

ADOPT UP TO 5 PETS
Bunnies, cats, dogs, foxes, frogs, pandas and horses come in 24 colors, including a Magical Horse. Each one has its own pixel animations, moods and little voice lines. Start with a free bunny, cat or dog, then adopt the ones you love.

DRESS THEM UP
Sunglasses, headphones and a bell collar. Unlock accessories with the XP you earned by focusing, or buy them outright. Bunnies wear them today, and more pets are getting their looks soon.

SEE WHERE YOUR TIME WENT
Weekly and yearly charts show exactly how much you've focused, so your streak is backed by real numbers instead of vibes.

A PET WITH OPINIONS
Turn on gentle daily reminders, written with a little attitude. ("Not mad. Just disappointed.")

COZY, NOT NOISY
No account needed, no ads, no feed, no social pressure, and no third-party trackers. Your data stays on your device and optionally syncs through your own private iCloud.

Perfect for studying, homework, exam revision, deep work, reading, or any stretch of time you want to protect.

—

Pypets is free to download and comes with free pets.

Optional in-app purchases:
• Pypets Forever: a one-time purchase that unlocks every premium pet, including pets added in future updates (accessories sold separately). Family Sharing supported.
• Individual pets and accessories: one-time purchases.

There are no subscriptions. Every purchase is one-time, nothing renews, and payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.

Turn your daily steps into a fun, rewarding adventure! Steppy is your new favorite walking companion that lives right on your Home Screen. If you struggle to find the motivation to walk, or just want a cute virtual pet to keep you company throughout the day, this app is built exactly for you.

Every step you take in the real world helps your pixel-art pet grow, wake up, and stay happy. Reach your daily step goals to see them evolve from sleepy little buddies to energetic friends. It’s like a classic virtual pet, but powered by your real-world movement!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE STEPPY:

Pets on Your Home Screen
Add beautifully designed widgets to your Home Screen. Keep an eye on your step count and your pet's mood at a glance, without even opening the app.

Walk to Wake Them Up!
Your pets rely on your daily activity to thrive. Hit your 5k, 10k, or custom step milestones to wake them up and level up their happiness. Every step makes a difference.

Collect Unique Pets & Earn Coins
Keep your walking routine fresh by unlocking a diverse collection of adorable pixel-art characters. You will naturally earn coins and attract new pets simply by walking and hitting your daily goals. Want to expand your collection faster? You have the option to buy coins and unlock your favorite friends instantly! From sleepy sloths to energetic bunnies, there’s a perfect companion waiting for you.

Track Your Daily Milestones
Monitor your progress effortlessly. Our intuitive widgets show exactly how close you are to your daily goal. Build healthy habits, hit your step targets, and maintain your walking streaks.

Customize Your Vibe
Choose from widgets of all sizes (small, medium, large) and styles. Customize the background colors to perfectly match your iPhone's aesthetic and wallpaper.

Cute Reminders to Move
Been sitting for too long? Get friendly, motivational notifications from your pet reminding you that it’s time for a walk.

Seamless Apple Health Integration
Steppy syncs perfectly with Apple HealthKit to track your steps accurately and securely in the background, ensuring minimum battery drain while you move.

Building healthy habits doesn't have to be boring. Let your new digital friends motivate you to get off the couch, hit your 10k steps, and improve your health one step at a time.

Download Steppy today and start walking with your new best friend!
